# Krishnendu Biswas

> AI systems developer and second-year MBA student at IIM Ranchi and BS in Data Science and Applications student at IIT Madras (Diploma in Programming completed). Builds and operates a personal multi-agent platform on open-source Hermes Agent with human approval gates.

## The story in ten chapters (home page, https://krishnendu.me/)
1. I build with agents: I am 23 and I study management at IIM Ranchi, in Ranchi. This page shows how a management student ended up running a team of AI agents.
2. Start here: what you can use today: I am a management student who learned to code. I built a small team of AI agents that cannot act without my approval, then used that team to ship apps for other students.
3. Where I started: A management degree, a programming diploma and three internships.
4. Learning the models first: Modelling projects and competitions came before any agent was allowed to act.
5. One assistant became nine: Today the team is nine agents. Sends, deletes and public pushes wait for my approval.
6. What the agents actually do: A voice note becomes a finished task. Risky steps wait for me.
7. Why you can trust the agents: Layers of checks keep agent work in check. When a layer misses something, the next one is built to catch it.
8. How the products are built: A closer look at Termly and CogPrep Arcade: the features, the code and the tools behind them.
9. Going deeper: Six case studies show the architecture. The code stays private.
10. What I believe and where I am going: What I believe, and what comes next.

## Key Verified Facts
- Multi-Agent Operations: 55 recurring scheduled jobs running across 9 agents (8 domain agents plus 1 router).
- Human Approval Gate: Sends, deletes and public pushes wait for my approval.
- QualityKiosk Internship: 2 deterministic TypeScript estimation engines (1,027 lines), 136 unit tests (68 Excel parity), 18,456 standardized QA rows.
- Research Publication: 74.19% recall on rare Confused emotion class using RoBERTa with SVMSMOTE, accepted for publication in Springer Nature proceedings, Smart Innovation, Systems and Technologies series, Scopus indexed (FICTA 2026).
- PRISMA Review: Systematic literature review of 29 Scopus articles on generative AI in marketing (10th Pan-IIM WMC 2025).
- ORCID: 0009-0006-1176-1106 (https://orcid.org/0009-0006-1176-1106).
- Certifications: Lean Six Sigma Green Belt (Grant Thornton, 2025). Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst (PL-300), passed Jun 2025.
